text_block_list.text: I get quite a jolt at the sound of an extremely loud thump. I run to the source, only to see Hishi Amazon in the central plaza, headbutting a tree.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Someone stopped me this morning and asked me if I was feeling all right, you see…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But man, I can't have the younger students gettin' worried over me. It's pathetic!
Her fatigue is quite evident, though… I should probably adjust her race schedule.
